Oh Suzanna by Oversee 30A | Perfect in Walton County Awards – Three-Time Diamond Winner – Best Rental Mgmt. 2026, 2025, 2024 Welcome to Oh Suzanna, an Old-Florida-style beach retreat. Complete with a private heated pool on a large private lot, you’ll love the blend of old Seagrove and modern comforts. The charming home rests between Seagrove and Seaside, providing endless opportunities for exploring the area on bike - cruise to four-star restaurants in flip-flops, and check out Seaside’s unique boutiques, wonderful eateries, and delightful tree-lined avenues. Plus, the Scenic 395 Beach Access is just a short (.25 mile) walk away, perfect for leisurely strolls to the soft white sand. Simply gorgeous, you’ve waited all year for this. After your adventures, unwind in your private oasis, a truly incredible space! Complete with a large private pool, fire pit(!), gas grill, hot tub/spa, and a screened-in back porch. Very nice. Inside, this coral and blue jewel, a very unique and charming home, features a cozy living area with a smart TV, a fully equipped kitchen, and comfortable sleeping arrangements for up to 10 guests. Your single-level getaway includes a primary ensuite, king, a guest room, king, and a charming bunk room with 4 twins.

The living room sofa transforms into an extra bed for added flexibility. Escape to Oh Suzanna for a one-of-a-kind beachy getaway. The gorgeous retreat is chock full of luxurious amenities, ideal for relaxation, recreation, and 30A adventures. Welcome! Our dedicated team at Oversee 30A, a local company, is committed to ensuring your stay is nothing short of exceptional. We strive for perfection and are just a stone's throw away should you require any assistance. Reach out to us anytime, seven days a week, with the added peace of a 24/7 emergency line. Overview: - 434 steps (.2 miles) to the beach (Scenic 395 Access) - 3 bedroom, 2 bath - 1268 sq ft - Gas grill - Wi-Fi - 3 bikes included - Hot tub and private pool (can be heated seasonally for an additional $55.00 per day, contact Oversee for details) Overnight: - King in 1st floor primary bedroom; private bath; TV - King in 1st floor guest room, shared bath; TV - Two twin bunks (4 twin beds) in first floor guest bedroom, shared bath; TV - Pullout sleeper sofa in living room Check-in is 4:00 PM CST. Checkout is 10:00 AM CST.
